sections.title: Introduction
content: FullStack Master ("we," "us," "our") operates fullstackmaster.net and provides online coaching services for technical professionals preparing for FAANG and senior technology leadership interviews.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information, including recordings of coaching sessions, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK GDPR, California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and other applicable international privacy laws.
By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

subsections.subtitle: Personal Information
items: Name, email address, phone number
Professional background and career goals
Payment and billing information (processed securely via third-party payment processors)
Communication preferences

subsections.subtitle: Session Data
items: Video and audio recordings of coaching sessions (with your explicit consent)
Chat logs and files shared during sessions
Session notes, feedback, and progress tracking
Mock interview responses and assessments

subsections.subtitle: Usage Data
items: IP address, browser type, device information
Pages visited and time spent on our website
Cookies and similar tracking technologies

sections.title: Session Recording - Consent & Usage
content: All coaching sessions may be recorded for specific purposes. Your explicit consent is required before any recording takes place.

subsections.subtitle: Why We Record Sessions
items: To provide you with session playback for your personal review and learning
For quality assurance and continuous improvement of our coaching services
For internal training purposes to enhance coaching methodologies
To create educational content for future clients (only with your additional written consent)

subsections.subtitle: Your Consent Rights
items: Before each session, you will be notified that recording may occur
You must actively opt-in by confirming consent verbally or in writing at the start of each session
You may withdraw consent at any time by notifying us via email or WhatsApp
If consent is withdrawn, we will stop recording and delete existing recordings upon request (subject to legal retention requirements)

subsections.subtitle: Educational Content & Learning Library
items: With your separate written consent, anonymized or identified session recordings may be used to create educational content
Such content may be made available through our subscription-based learning library on YouTube or our platform
You will receive a separate consent form specifically for educational content usage
You may opt out of educational content usage while still participating in coaching sessions
If your session is used for educational purposes, your identity may be anonymized upon request

subsections.subtitle: Recording Storage & Security
items: Recordings are stored securely with industry-standard encryption (AES-256)
Access is limited to authorized personnel and your personal account
Personal session recordings are retained for 90 days unless you request extension or deletion
Educational content recordings are retained as long as the learning library is active

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
items: Deliver and improve our coaching services
Process payments and manage your account
Send service-related communications (session reminders, follow-ups, policy updates)
Provide access to session recordings and educational content
Comply with legal obligations (tax reporting, dispute resolution)
With your opt-in consent, send marketing emails about new courses and services

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
content: We do NOT sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

subsections.subtitle: We may share information with
items: Service Providers: Payment processors, video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Google Meet), email services
Legal Requirements: If required by law, court order, or to protect rights and safety
Business Transfers: In the event of a merger or acquisition (you will be notified in advance)

sections.title: International Data Transfers
content: Our services are offered globally, including to clients in the USA, UK, European Union, Australia, Singapore, and other countries.
If you are located in the EU/UK, your data may be transferred to servers in the United States. We ensure adequate safeguards through:
- Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with service providers
- Data Processing Agreements with all vendors
- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
content: Depending on your location, you have the following rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws:

rights.description: Request a copy of your personal data we hold
Request deletion of your data ("Right to be Forgotten")
Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Limit how we use your data
Revoke consent for session recordings or marketing at any time

sections.exerciseRights: To exercise any of these rights, email us at rupesh@fullstackmaster.net or contact us via WhatsApp. We will respond within 30 days (GDPR) or 45 days (CCPA).

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
content: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website:
items: Essential Cookies: Required for website functionality (login, session management)
Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors use our site (Google Analytics with anonymized IP)
Marketing Cookies: Used only with your consent for remarketing purposes

sections.title: Data Security
content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
items: Encryption for data transmission (TLS 1.3) and storage (AES-256)
Secure payment processing through PCI-compliant providers
Regular security reviews and updates
Limited access to personal data on a need-to-know basis

sections.title: Children's Privacy
content: Our services are intended for professionals aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 18. If we become aware of such data, we will delete it promptly.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. Updates will be posted on this page with a new "Last Updated" date. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact Us
content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us:
sections.supervisoryAuthority: For EU/UK users: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (e.g., UK ICO: ico.org.uk, or your country's equivalent).
